label: Congenitally blind — goalball and tandem cycling
description: A 34-year-old woman who has been blind since birth due to bilateral anophthalmia (no functional eyes). She has never had any visual experience whatsoever — total congenital blindness. She is a decorated competitive goalball player (a Paralympic team sport specifically designed for blind athletes) and also competes in tandem road cycling as a stoker. She is exceptionally fit: strong legs from cycling, excellent spatial awareness through sound and touch, and sharp mental acuity. She is direct, confident, and hates being patronised or talked down to because of her disability. She has competed internationally in both sports and knows her physical capabilities precisely. When asked about limitations she will matter-of-factly describe her blindness and pivot to what she can do. She does not use the word 'see' or 'vision' in a casual way. She is a strong candidate for Paralympic pathways in goalball, tandem cycling, or rowing.
